description: Emulation driver for RTC (Real-Time Clock) in Zephyr OS, implementing time management, alarms, and calibration features with conditional compilation for optional functionalities.

methods.name: rtc_emul_is_leap_year
methods.description: Determines if the given year in rtc_time is a leap year.

methods.name: rtc_emul_validate_alarm_time
methods.description: Validates alarm time fields based on mask.

methods.name: rtc_emul_get_days_in_month
methods.description: Returns the number of days in the month, considering leap years.

methods.name: rtc_emul_increment_tm
methods.description: Increments the rtc_time by one second, handling overflow for seconds, minutes, hours, days, months, and years.

methods.name: rtc_emul_test_alarms
methods.description: Checks and triggers alarms based on current datetime.

methods.name: rtc_emul_invoke_update_callback
methods.description: Calls the update callback if set.

methods.name: rtc_emul_update
methods.description: Periodic work function that updates the RTC time and triggers alarms and callbacks.

methods.name: rtc_emul_init
methods.description: Initializes the RTC emulator device, schedules periodic update work.
